exposure: Biocellulose film with underwater adhesive (BCF-adhesive) for spina bifida repair
Human umbilical cord with suture (HUC-suture) for spina bifida repair
cohort: Sixteen sheep fetuses with surgically created spina bifida defects at 75 days' gestation.
finding: Cryopreserved human umbilical cord with suture effectively healed spina bifida defects, preserved spinal cord integrity, and prevented Chiari II malformation in sheep fetuses, outperforming biocellulose film with adhesive.
gest_age: Spina bifida created at 75 days' gestation; repair performed at 95 days' gestation; final analysis at term.
